summary.text: Jeff Zenger is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 74 who has served since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A general contractor and developer, he is House Majority Conference Co-Chair.

paragraphs.text: Zenger graduated from Towson High School in 1982, and his career experience includes owning Lisha Construction.
The General Assembly's website lists his occupation as general contractor and developer.
Zenger assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2021, succeeding Wes Schollander.
He represents Forsyth County and is House Majority Conference Co-Chair.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Housing and Development and Regulatory Reform committees and is a member of the Appropriations, Election Law, and Energy and Public Utilities committees, among others.
